mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `erp_order` WHERE TO_DAYS(create_time) = TO_DAYS(NOW())
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM `erp_order` WHERE TO_DAYS(create_time) = TO_DAYS(NOW()) AND status != 4
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `erp_order` WHERE status IN (0, 1)

SELECT msg FROM ( SELECT CONCAT('新订单: ', order_no, ' (¥', total_amount, ')') as msg, create_time FROM erp_order UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('库存盘点: ', p.name, ' (', s.change_amount, ')') as msg, s.create_time FROM erp_stock_record s LEFT JOIN erp_product p ON s.product_id = p.id ) t ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 10
